name_reason: Follows convention data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=audio), encodes the data type via the _ptr suffix, and accurately names the role (pointer to the loaded BGM/FDMUS.DAT sequence data buffer). No Ghidra address residue in the name; _53ee0 not present. No domain ID involved.
purpose: Runtime pointer to the currently loaded BGM sequence data buffer (an FDMUS.DAT entry), held across calls to fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade.
logic_summary: Zero in the image (BSS). The sole accessor fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade reads it first as a NULL test: on the very first track it is NULL so AIL_stop_sequence is skipped (00025977 CMP dword ptr [0x53ee0],0 / JZ). It is then overwritten at 00025a02 (MOV [0x53ee0],EAX) with the return pointer of fd2_load_dat_resource("FDMUS.DAT", old_buf, track_id), and that pointer is passed to fd2_dpmi_lock_size (DPMI-lock the loaded sequence) and AIL_init_sequence (00025a18 PUSH dword ptr [0x53ee0]). Accessed only as a 32-bit value (CMP/PUSH/MOV dword ptr).
datatype: uint32 (pointer-sized; Ghidra type undefined4, used as a far/near pointer to the FDMUS.DAT sequence buffer)
element_semantics: Single scalar: a 32-bit pointer to the loaded BGM sequence data buffer (FDMUS.DAT[track_id] entry). NULL when no BGM sequence has been loaded yet.
notes: Only accessor is fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade (xrefs: READ 000259c9, READ 000259ef, WRITE 00025a02, READ 00025a18). Write at 00025a02 => not const (correctly emitted as plain non-const uint32 in audio.c). src comment block (audio.c lines 307-314) is accurate and ASCII-clean; left unchanged. Ghidra data plate at 0x53ee0 is mutually consistent with src (same role, same NULL-test behavior, same write site 0x25A02, same not-const conclusion) and symbol name is byte-identical => plate left unchanged. No src/audio/audio.c edit was made for this symbol.
